subject: general
question: Michael Phelps is associated with which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swimming.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Michael Phelps

 
 
• He is ​an American former competitive swimmer.
 
• He is the most successful and most decorated Olympian of all time with a total of 28 medals.
 
• Phelps also holds the record for Olympic gold medals with a total of 23 medals.
 
• Phelps is the long course world record holder in the men's 400-meter individual medley as well as the former long course world record holder in the 200-meter freestyle, 100-meter butterfly, 200-meter butterfly, and 200-meter individual medley.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Olympics 

 
 
• Olympic Games originated in ancient Greece.
 
• The Summer Olympics have been held **every four years since 1896"**
 
• The honour of holding the Olympic Games is entrusted to a city, not to a country.
 
• The architect of the modern Olympics Games was Pierre, baron de Coubertin.
 
 

a7
